rules: A price is used only when an entry below gives it. A null price means unknown, and any cost that needs it is reported as null with a reason, never as zero.
A zero price appears only where the provider lists the unit as free; the leaderboard labels such costs as tariff-zero.
Every entry names where the price was read and when. Re-check each entry against the source before a test run and change checked_on.
